Hey there! 👋 Here's the scoop on **ktor-batterypack** 🔋

**What is it?**
It's a **Kotlin** project built on the **Ktor** framework. Think of it as a battery pack ⚡ for Ktor apps - it comes pre-loaded with some handy features:

• **Content Negotiation** - automatic content conversion based on headers
• **kotlinx.serialization** - JSON serialization
• **PostgreSQL** - database support
• **Exposed** - ORM/database framework
• **Status Pages** - exception handling for routes

It's a starter project generated from the [Ktor Project Generator](https://start.ktor.io), likely being expanded into a more full-featured library or template.

---

**🐛 Open Issues to Pick Up:**

1. **#20** - Bump JUnit to version 6
2. **#19** - Bump JUnit to version 6 *(duplicate?)*
3. **#13** - feat: implement DLT (Dead Letter Stream) with retry and exception classification
4. **#11** - Add timeout and backpressure handling to Redis stream publishing

The DLT and Redis issues look like the juiciest ones to tackle if you're looking to make a real impact! 🚀 The JUnit bump is probably a quick win though. 💪

Want me to grab more details on any of these? 😎
